source_gate.selection: Use NSE wherever it publishes the required observation; investigate the named authoritative alternatives otherwise.
source_gate.candidate_urls: Research leads only; resolved definitions, verified routes and remaining gates are in source-catalog.json.

common_requirements.missing: Return null with an explicit reason for unresolved definitions, inaccessible sources or missing observations; never use PNG example values.
common_requirements.history: Keep source period IDs, labels, basis, bounds, frequency and revisions. The displayed window is configurable after coverage verification; no forward-fill or invented dates.
common_requirements.comparison: Return a verified reference series/period and explicit delta unit only when coverage, definition, units and periods align. Otherwise return null.
common_requirements.source_metadata: Every observation needs the originating URL, publisher and NSE attribution. Derived values retain all input sources and periods.
common_requirements.dates: Keep observation/as-of precision and meaning separate from publication, retrieval, check and last-success timestamps; unknown publication dates remain null.
common_requirements.freshness: Release-aware freshness and retention permission belong to each observation. Polling frequency is not source frequency or a freshness guarantee.
common_requirements.normalization: Preserve decimal precision; convert verified source scales on the server. Definition, vintage, revisions and transform/input IDs must survive the M4 handoff.
common_requirements.chart: The backend supplies validated periods, units, domain, ticks and precision. Summary and history definitions must match. Do not fix the PNG's illustrative axes or data window.

panels.reference_periods: PNG shows five year labels (2021 through 2025); actual release years and retained window remain source-dependent.
open_questions: India fiscal-year versus World calendar-year comparability
Annual real growth versus quarterly YoY; constant-price base, revisions and actual versus forecast
Reference period for each summary's percentage-point change

series.definition_candidate: India annual real GDP growth, with source year/basis and constant-price methodology preserved.
series.history_requirement: Annual observations with matching definitions; do not pair unlike years without explicit labels.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior comparable annual growth; change in percentage points, reference year required.

series.definition_candidate: World aggregate annual real GDP growth; WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG / WLD is the M1 candidate, not a locked source.
series.history_requirement: Annual aggregate observations; verify aggregation, revisions and historical window.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior comparable annual growth; do not substitute India's growth as the change reference.

panels.reference_periods: Summary says FY25 but the PNG axis shows Jul/Aug days. Debt history must follow authentic reporting periods; daily interpolation is prohibited.
open_questions: Central versus general-government debt; gross versus net and GDP denominator
Fiscal versus calendar year and actual versus estimated figures
The second summary says Ind vs US: ratio, gap and comparison definition are unresolved (see unbound_requirements)

series.definition_candidate: India government debt divided by matching nominal GDP; scope must be selected before use.
series.history_requirement: Reported annual ratios only, consistent government coverage and vintage.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior comparable annual ratio; delta in percentage points.

panels.reference_periods: PNG has annual labels and USD-billion summary amounts but percentage chart axes; retain monetary units consistently, pending definition selection.
open_questions: Goods only versus goods plus services
Monthly, full fiscal-year or calendar-year coverage; do not mix cumulative and monthly flows
Source USD scale and revisions; monetary comparisons cannot inherit the PNG's pp label

series.definition_candidate: India imports in USD billions for a verified coverage and period.
series.history_requirement: Same coverage, currency and period as exports and balance.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior matching period amount; choose explicitly between USD-billion delta and percentage change.

series.definition_candidate: India exports in USD billions for the same coverage and period as imports.
series.history_requirement: Same coverage, currency and period as imports and balance.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior matching period amount; choose explicitly between USD-billion delta and percentage change.

series.definition_candidate: Exports minus imports; deficits are negative, on matched inputs only.
series.history_requirement: Aligned inputs for every point; gaps remain missing.
series.comparison_requirement: No separate summary slot; any later delta needs comparable inputs and an explicit unit.

transform_candidate.gate: M3.5: identical period, currency, scope, revision and units; retain both input references.

panels.reference_periods: PNG shows annual labels, a YOY heading, a percent collection value and an unlabelled average. M2 amount bindings are provisional; no collection-to-growth substitution.
open_questions: Gross versus net and refund treatment
Annual total versus one month's collection; fiscal/calendar year and complete versus partial windows
Average window, missing months and source adjustments
If growth is required, approve a separate definition/series instead of putting percentages in INR-crore fields

series.definition_candidate: India GST collection amount, provisionally gross, for a clearly labelled verified period.
series.history_requirement: Annual totals require complete comparable coverage or explicit YTD labels; verify published aggregates before summing months.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior matched window; percent change versus absolute INR-crore delta must be explicit.

series.definition_candidate: Monthly average GST amount over the same labelled collection window; formula/window pending.
series.history_requirement: One verified average per labelled window; preserve constituent months and count.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior window with identical length and coverage; no percentage-point delta on monetary amounts.

transform_candidate.gate: M3.5: acquire underlying monthly amounts for each window; no averaging annual totals or dividing incomplete totals by 12.

panels.reference_periods: PNG's chart uses annual labels; candidate CPI releases are monthly. Select a monthly history or a specifically defined annual aggregation; never relabel months as years.
open_questions: All-India combined headline CPI versus rural/urban or another measure; current base and rebasing continuity
History granularity and summary reference month
Applicable RBI policy target, legal validity dates and tolerance band; do not assume the PNG's target remains current

series.definition_candidate: All-India combined headline CPI year-on-year inflation for a labelled observation month.
series.history_requirement: Monthly published YoY rates or a verified transformation; preserve base changes and revisions.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior comparable monthly YoY rate; change in percentage points with explicit reference month.

series.definition_candidate: Published inflation policy target applicable to the CPI observation date, with verified effective interval.
series.history_requirement: Effective policy intervals, not sampled CPI data; only render a reference where applicable.
series.comparison_requirement: PNG delta is ambiguous; omit unless a verified policy revision or CPI-to-target gap is explicitly defined.

panels.reference_periods: PNG uses annual labels with percentage summaries/axis and unlabelled stacked amounts. M2 amount bindings need matched fiscal periods and INR-crore amounts, pending source selection.
open_questions: Union government versus all levels of government
Actual, provisional actual, budget estimate or revised estimate; do not mix categories
Full FY versus cumulative year-to-date figures; monthly flows must be explicitly derived
Use source reconciliation/rounding precision when checking total against capital plus revenue

series.definition_candidate: Union government capital expenditure, coverage and estimate category pending.
series.history_requirement: Same fiscal window, revision and estimate category as revenue and total.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior matching fiscal window and category; explicitly choose amount delta or percent growth.

series.definition_candidate: Union government revenue expenditure for the same window/category as capital.
series.history_requirement: Aligned capital/revenue stack; source numbers only, no fabricated complementary amount.
series.comparison_requirement: No separate summary slot; any later comparison requires matched fiscal windows/categories.

series.definition_candidate: Published total Union government expenditure matching capital and revenue; source reconciliation required.
series.history_requirement: Supplied total annotations on aligned fiscal periods; frontend does not calculate the total.
series.comparison_requirement: Prior matching fiscal window and category; explicitly choose amount delta or percent growth.

unbound_requirements.label: Ind vs US
unbound_requirements.requirement: Determine whether the second card is US debt/GDP, an India-US gap or another comparison. Require identical government coverage, vintage and comparable period before adding a canonical series and delta.

ticker.comparison_requirement: Verify previous official close and session. Change points = quote minus previous close; percent = change / previous close * 100 only for a valid nonzero reference, using decimal arithmetic on the server.
ticker.history_requirement: No ticker chart requested; previous close and its session/date are required to validate displayed changes.
ticker.timing_requirement: Source quote timestamp and timezone, exchange trading date, open/closed status and holidays; retrieval time cannot substitute for quote time.
ticker.cadence_requirement: Feed delay, permissions, refresh interval and non-trading behavior remain unverified. Use unknown cadence until verified; never claim LIVE from the PNG.
